questions.question: What did the tumor–CTL coculture establish about tumor-cell PD-L1 acting directly on cytotoxic T cells?

options.A: With only tumor cells and antigen-specific CTLs present, tPD-L1 conferred no survival advantage to tumor cells
options.B: tPD-L1 completely blocked CTL killing whenever tumor cells expressed gp70
options.C: PD-L1 deletion impaired CTL activation only when myeloid cells were absent
options.D: Tumor PD-L1 directly suppressed CTL cytotoxicity but not activation

questions.rationale: The study separates direct tumor–CTL effects from an indirect mechanism requiring the metastatic niche and myeloid cells.
questions.evidence_quote: These results indicate that tPD-L1 confers no survival advantage when an antigen-specific effector CTL encounters a tumor cell bearing a cognate peptide-MHC complex, free from any other tumor microenvironmental factors.

questions.question: What pattern did tumor-cell PD-L1 knockout produce in primary growth versus lung metastasis?

options.A: Primary tumor growth was unchanged, but lung metastasis decreased in a CTL-dependent manner
options.B: Primary tumors shrank, but lung metastases increased independently of CTLs
options.C: Both primary and metastatic growth decreased equally in RAGII-KO mice
options.D: Primary tumor growth increased while lung colonization was unchanged

questions.rationale: The results distinguish a metastatic-site immune-evasion function from a primary-tumor growth effect.
questions.evidence_quote: Intriguingly, no difference was observed in primary tumor growth, supporting our in vitro cytotoxicity results (Fig 2A , S2B ). No differences in tumor growth were observed in the WT and PD-L1 KO CT26 tumor at the site of tumor cell injection (Fig. 2E ).

questions.question: Which controls argued that tPD-L1 promotes lung metastasis through immune escape rather than initial lung seeding?

options.A: Initial gp70 colonization was unchanged at day 1, and WT versus knockout tumors grew equally in RAGII-KO mice
options.B: Knockout cells seeded more strongly at day 1 and grew faster in RAGII-KO mice
options.C: Primary tumors were larger in knockout mice, but lung seeding was not measured
options.D: The effect persisted without adaptive immunity and was linked to extravasation

questions.rationale: No initial colonization difference and loss of the genotype effect in adaptive-immune-deficient mice point to CTL-mediated clearance rather than seeding.
questions.evidence_quote: No difference in initial tumor cell colonization as measured by tumor cell gp70 level in the lungs was seen one day after tail vein injection (Fig. 3B ), demonstrating that PD-L1 does not enhance DTC colonization efficiency in the lung. Similarly, PD-L1-deficient and competent 4T1 metastasized equally in adaptive-immune deficient congenic RAGII-KO mice (Fig 3C )

questions.question: What happened to CD3+ infiltration after tPD-L1 loss, and where was the change observed?

options.A: It increased in lung metastases but not in the primary tumor
options.B: It decreased in lung metastases but increased in the primary tumor
options.C: It increased equally in both sites
options.D: It did not change in either site

questions.rationale: The spatially selective change supports a metastatic-niche effect on T-cell recruitment.
questions.evidence_quote: Increased infiltration of CD3 + cells after loss of tPD-L1 in lung, but not in the primary tumor were observed (Fig. 3A ), which indicate that tPD-L1 blocked T cell infiltration at the metastatic site.

questions.question: What cell population showed transcriptional remodeling in the lung niche after tumor PD-L1 loss, rather than a shift in overall myeloid abundance?

options.A: Myeloid cells showed altered interferon-related state, while bulk myeloid composition did not change
options.B: CTLs changed transcriptionally, while macrophage abundance doubled
options.C: Only tumor cells changed, while leukocytes were unaffected
options.D: Myeloid cells disappeared entirely from the lung

questions.rationale: The authors distinguish state changes in myeloid cells from an altered bulk proportion of myeloid cells.
questions.evidence_quote: Validating our transcriptomic data, no change in bulk lung myeloid cell composition was observed, though enhanced antigen presentation machinery was detected in macrophages

questions.question: How did tumor-cell engagement with macrophage PD-1 alter signaling in RAW264.7 cocultures?

options.A: It enhanced SHP-2 activation, decreased pSTAT1, and reduced MHC-II expression
options.B: It reduced SHP-2, increased pSTAT1, and raised MHC-II expression
options.C: It had no effect unless CTL PD-1 was also engaged
options.D: It increased IFN-β and MHC-II while eliminating PD-1

questions.rationale: These coculture findings connect tPD-L1–mPD-1 engagement to attenuated interferon/STAT1 signaling and antigen presentation.
questions.evidence_quote: Engagement with 4T1 tPD-L1 enhanced SHP-2 activation and decreased pSTAT1 levels in RAW cells, diminishing expression of MHC class II both on 4T1 and RAW cells

questions.question: What result supports a negative-feedback relationship between PD-1/PD-L1 and type I interferon in the coculture system?

options.A: Disrupting RAW PD-1 or 4T1 PD-L1 enhanced IFN-β production, while IFN-β can induce PD-L1/L2
options.B: Disrupting either receptor abolished IFN-β, which then suppressed PD-L1
options.C: IFN-β had no effect on checkpoint molecules
options.D: PD-1 loss reduced sensitivity to poly(I:C) and lowered interferon

questions.rationale: The axis is induced by interferon yet feeds back to attenuate interferon signaling.
questions.evidence_quote: Accordingly, disruption of RAW PD-1 expression or 4T1 PD-L1 expression enhanced IFN production (Fig. 6J ). Given the identity of IFN as a potent PD-L1/L2 inducer 24 , these findings demonstrate the existence of a negative feedback circuit in which the PD-1/L1 axis is induced by and then attenuates type I interferon signaling.

questions.question: What happened when myeloid cells were depleted with clodronate liposomes?

options.A: The ability of tPD-L1 to promote lung tumor growth was diminished
options.B: tPD-L1 drove stronger metastasis despite depletion
options.C: Only primary tumor growth changed, not lung metastasis
options.D: Myeloid depletion increased the number of metastases in every group

questions.rationale: The depletion experiment functionally tests myeloid cells as intermediaries linking tumor PD-L1 to metastatic immune escape.
questions.evidence_quote: we depleted myeloid cells by clodronate liposomes in tumor-bearing mice and analyzed tumor growth in the lungs. Depletion of myeloid cells diminished tPD-L1 function in promoting tumor growth in the lungs in this experimental lung metastasis model

questions.question: What human patient observation was consistent with the mouse myeloid-interferon mechanism?

options.A: In metastatic basal cell carcinoma, myeloid cells showed enhanced interferon signaling, antigen presentation, and CTL-recruiting chemokines after PD-1 blockade
options.B: PD-1 blockade reduced all myeloid interferon and chemokine expression
options.C: Only tumor-cell expression changed, with no myeloid response
options.D: A lung adenocarcinoma cohort showed no association between interferon and response

questions.rationale: The human single-cell dataset showed a myeloid-state shift after checkpoint blockade aligned with the proposed recruitment mechanism.
questions.evidence_quote: Myeloid cell PHATE analysis revealed differentiation restriction that was released following PD-1 blockade, leading to enhanced interferon signaling, antigen presentation, and CTL-recruiting chemokine expression

questions.question: What explicit limitation constrains extension of these findings to metastases at other anatomical sites?

options.A: The study analyzed only lung metastases, whose barrier-tissue microenvironment may be unusually inflamed
options.B: The study analyzed only primary tumors and no metastases
options.C: The study used human patients exclusively and no mouse models
options.D: The study tested every metastatic organ but no immune cells

questions.rationale: The authors caution that lung-specific niche biology may limit generalization to other metastatic tissues.
questions.evidence_quote: One limitation in this study is that we exclusively analyzed lung metastases, which due to their location in barrier tissue, may have a uniquely inflamed microenvironment
